per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled all linked assay/experiment/literature rows. caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary article gives hemolysis percentages at 1000 μg.mL−1 and reports 0.46/0.50/0.40 μM, while DBAASP rows encode 460/500/400 µM. Percent hemolysis is retained; molar-scale conflict remains in database audit.
dbAMP/APD/CAMP generic or cross-paper annotations can be broader than the 2017 primary Table 3/prose; source-supported subsets are retained and conflicts are not smoothed.
Local supplementary support is a HPLC/MS image asset for synthesized peptide characterization; no supplementary spreadsheet/table changed activity/toxicity/mechanism curation.
Mechanism curation uses prose-supported Fig. 4/Fig. 8 quantitative statements and does not fabricate additional curve-read values.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 for the ocellatin-LB1/LB2/F1 paper. The final state is accepted_with_cautions, not clean acceptance, because database conflict cautions are deliberately preserved.
